subject.title: Subagent process death emits no telemetry — sessions_spawn failures leave no span/trace

question: What stable diagnostics contract should OpenClaw expose when a spawned subagent dies or is terminated after sessions_spawn returns?
rationale: The missing emission point is clear, but schema, span parenting, low-cardinality reason values, and privacy treatment are public observability contract choices.

options.title: Add subagent terminal event
options.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and map it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

options.title: Annotate spawn span only
options.body: Attach failure information to the parent sessions_spawn tool span, accepting weaker coverage for deaths that happen after the spawn call returns.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle redesign
options.body: Defer this to broader subagent lifecycle reliability work, accepting that downstream death clustering remains blind until that design lands.

recommendation.title: Add subagent terminal event
recommendation.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and map it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both subagent lifecycle ownership and the original diagnostics event surface.
